name: Communist Party of India (undivided)
summary_card: The undivided CPI, active in Bengal's agrarian organizing through its peasant front, the Kisan Sabha.
full_entry: Refers here to the Communist Party of India prior to its 1964 split into the CPI and CPI(M) -- a separate entity to build later, linked back to this one with a 'split_from' relationship.
editor_note: Founding date and location (Tashkent 1920 vs Kanpur 1925) are described differently across sources -- resolve this with a dedicated, well-sourced entity before publishing rather than guessing here.

name: All India Kisan Sabha
summary_card: The undivided CPI's national peasant front; the Bengal Provincial Kisan Sabha was its provincial wing.
full_entry: Founded in 1936 as the national peasant organization associated with the undivided Communist Party of India.

name: Bengal Provincial Kisan Sabha (Bangiya Pradeshik Kisan Sabha)
summary_card: The Bengal wing of the Kisan Sabha that organized and led the Tebhaga movement.
full_entry: The Bengal provincial wing of the All India Kisan Sabha. Passed the September 1946 resolution that launched the Tebhaga movement.

sources.citation: The Tebhaga Movement: A Revolutionary Peasant Uprising in Bengal, PolSci Institute
